card.fires_on: The space or digit just before or inside a number (percent, age, range, rate) in text that is about women, such as women's health studies or women's pay and unemployment.

modes.label: Space before a figure
modes.description: The space token right before a number in statistics about women.

modes.label: Inside a number or range
modes.description: A digit, decimal point, or range joiner partway through a figure about women.

card.writes: It suppresses words for women and female, so the model is pushed to continue with the number itself rather than repeating the word women.
card.plain: It fires on numbers in text about women and makes the model write digits instead of the word women.
